Stop and disable only threetched-fs-native; its daemon owns --auto-unmount. finish has no explicit unmount and cannot affect a preexisting/foreign mount on refused startup.
Restore the prior received native/service selector if required.
Retain the guest mount owner1000000, identities, credentials, backend grants, all other allowed_roots and authoritative data.

allowed_root_ownership_receipt.rollback: Marker removal/false and deliberate tched-router restart remove only this exact root if the protected ownership receipt exists, then remove the receipt. All unrelated roots remain; preexisting permission without receipt remains.

Deliberately start the optional mount and verify its exact session/local owner and release catalog.
Deliberately restart tched-router using the reviewed live-base filesystem-only candidate and received native manifest pair; opt-in refuses startup until the exact mount is ready.
Confirm matching-session read receipt and foreign-session/mutation denial through the mounted path. Owner-assigned agent executes tests.
